summary: POMDOCTOR LIMITED, a NASDAQ-listed Chinese digital healthcare company (ticker POM), filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release and investor presentation announcing participation in H.C. Wainwright's 28th Annual Global Investment Conference, held September 14-16, 2026, at the Lotte New York Palace Hotel. A pre-recorded virtual presentation becomes available on demand September 11, 2026, at 7:00 a.m. ET, with Chairman/CEO Zhenyang Shi and COO Wanmei Shi available for one-on-one meetings. No transaction, stake, price, or board recommendation is disclosed. This is a routine investor-relations conference notice, not a special situation; no risk-arb angle applies.
